nodes.summary: Extinction is certain iff the mean offspring number is at most `1`, provided the offspring number is not almost surely `1` (Athreya–Ney 1972, ch. I).
nodes.title: Galton–Watson extinction criterion

nodes.summary: The extinction probability `q = sup_n P(Z_n = 0)`, the limit of the probabilities of extinction by generation `n` (`tendsto_law_real_zero`). On a path space carrying the process the events `{Z_n = 0}` increase with `n` (`0` is absorbing), so `q` is the probability of eventual extinction; this file describes the process through its generation laws and does not construct the path space.
nodes.title: Extinction probability of a Galton–Watson process

nodes.summary: The least fixed point is `1` iff the mean offspring number is at most `1`, provided the offspring number is not almost surely `1` (Athreya–Ney 1972, ch. I).
nodes.title: Least fixed point equals one iff mean offspring is at most one

nodes.summary: The extinction probability is the least fixed point of the offspring generating function in `[0, 1]` (Athreya–Ney 1972, ch. I).
nodes.title: Extinction probability is the least fixed point

nodes.summary: `sup_n f^[n](0)` is the least fixed point of `f` in `[0, 1]` (Athreya–Ney 1972, ch. I).
nodes.title: Limit of generating-function iterates is the least fixed point

nodes.summary: The iterates `f^[n](s)` of the offspring generating function stay in `[0, 1]` for `s ∈ [0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Iterates of the offspring generating function stay in (0, 1)
Probability of extinction by generation n

nodes.summary: The law of the generation size `Z_n` of the Galton–Watson process with offspring law `ν` started from one individual: `Z_0 = 1` and, given `Z_n = z`, `Z_{n+1}` has law `ν^{∗z}` (`Measure.convPow ν z`).
nodes.title: Generation-size law of a Galton–Watson process

nodes.summary: The mean generation size is `E Z_n = m ^ n` (Athreya–Ney 1972, ch. I).
nodes.title: Mean generation size of a Galton–Watson process

nodes.summary: The mean offspring number `m = E ξ = ∑ k ν{k} ∈ [0, ∞]`.
nodes.title: Mean offspring number

nodes.summary: The iterates `f^[n](0)` of the offspring generating function are non-decreasing.
nodes.title: Iterates of the generating function at zero are nondecreasing
Extinction by generation n is nondecreasing in n

nodes.summary: The generating function of `Z_n` is the `n`-th iterate of the offspring generating function on `[0, 1]` (Athreya–Ney 1972, ch. I).
nodes.title: Generating function of the n-th generation size
Extinction by generation n converges to the extinction probability

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
